note: Set A correctly identifies elevation titles (e.g., North Kitchen Elevation) more often than Set B, which repeatedly mislabels D5 as 'South Bathroom Elevation D5' despite the text clearly stating 'North Kitchen'. Both sets struggle with binding dimensions to the correct elevation (e.g., attributing East Kitchen widths to North Kitchen), but Set B makes more fundamental errors in dimension types (claiming a vertical height is a total width) and component labels (assigning shower pan height to MWB01). Set A is more faithful to the text labels even when dimension binding fails.
